Question 16
?

The line segment XY― is a diameter of a circle. Given that X and Y have coordinates (−3,0) and (1,−2), respectively, what is the equation of the circle?

a
(x+1)2+(y+1)2=5
b
(x−1)2+(y−1)2=5
c
(x+1)2+(y+1)2=20
d
(x+1)2+(y−1)2=5
e
(x−1)2+(y−1)2=20
Submit
